spec.title: 1 · Group scanning
spec.description: Instagram group-chat scan and last completion time in Singapore. The scan runs five minutes after the previous completion; downstream Receipts is a separate worker. Timing updates about every two minutes; missing or stale timing shows Unavailable. Hover the status for worker state and schedule details.

spec.root_selector:
def stamp: sub("[.][0-9]+Z$";"Z") | fromdateiso8601;
def sgt: . + 28800 | strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M SGT");
if .nextPageToken then error("Worker timing response truncated") else
  [.timeSeries[]? | {field:.metric.labels.field, point:(.points | sort_by(.interval.endTime) | last)}] as $rows |
  ($rows | map(select(.field == "status")) | first | .point) as $p |
  ($p != null and (now - ($p.interval.endTime | stamp)) <= 360 and
    (($p.interval.endTime | stamp) - now) <= 120 and
    ($p.value.int64Value | tonumber | IN(0,1,2,3,4))) as $fresh |
  (if $fresh then ($p.value.int64Value | tonumber) else 4 end) as $status |
  ([$rows[] | select(.point.interval.endTime == $p.interval.endTime) |
    {key:.field,value:(.point.value.int64Value | tonumber)}] | from_entries) as $v |
  [
    {details:("IG polling — " + (["Down","Healthy","Degraded","Paused","Unknown"][$status] // "Unknown") +
      "\nLast scan completion: " + (if $fresh and ($v.last_completion // 0) > 0 then ($v.last_completion | sgt) else "Unavailable" end) +
      "\nWorker: " + (if $fresh and $v.running == 1 then "Running" elif $fresh and $v.running == 0 then "Idle" else "Not observed" end) +
      "\nSchedule: 5 minutes after the previous run finishes (plus timer scheduling delay)." +
      "\nCompletion includes scans with no new images; it does not mean a payment was posted." +
      "\nObserved: " + (if $p != null then ($p.interval.endTime | stamp | sgt) else "Unavailable" end) +
      (if $fresh then "\nTiming telemetry updates about every 2 minutes." else "\nTelemetry missing or older than 6 minutes; refresh for current status." end)),
     status:$status},
    {details:"Last scan completion",status:(if $fresh and ($v.last_completion // 0) > 0 then $v.last_completion * 1000 else null end)}
  ][]
end

spec.description: Current official OpenAI product status. Hover the light for active incident details and Singapore update/check time; click for the official incident/status page. Provider-wide status, not an account or quota test. Unknown means the current response is unavailable or unrecognized.

spec.root_selector:
def sgt: try (sub("[.][0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601 | . + 28800 | strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M SGT")) catch "Time unavailable";
def text: if type == "string" then . else "" end;
.summary as $s | ["ChatGPT", "Codex"][] as $product |
([$s.structure.items[]?.group? | select(.name == $product)] | first) as $group |
[$group.components[]? | select(.hidden != true) | .component_id] as $ids |
[$s.affected_components[]? | select(.component_id as $id | $ids | index($id))] as $affected |
[$s.ongoing_incidents[]? | select(.status != "resolved" and .status != "closed") | select(any(.affected_components[]?; .component_id as $id | $ids | index($id)))] as $incidents |
(($s.id == "01JMDK9XYNY6RXSED6SDWW50WY") and ($s.name == "OpenAI") and (($s.affected_components | type) == "array") and (($s.ongoing_incidents | type) == "array") and ($ids | length) > 0 and (all($s.ongoing_incidents[]?; (.affected_components | type) == "array" and (.affected_components | length) > 0)) and (all($affected[]; .status == "operational" or .status == "degraded_performance" or .status == "partial_outage" or .status == "full_outage" or .status == "major_outage" or .status == "under_maintenance"))) as $valid |
(if $valid != true then 4 elif any($affected[]; .status == "full_outage" or .status == "major_outage") then 0 elif any($affected[]; .status != "operational") or ($incidents | length) > 0 then 2 else 1 end) as $status |

spec.title: Bridge availability
